# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target suspects the actions of his associates (GM may give descriptions that
arouse the player’s own suspicions).
@@ 2
One of the target’s personal traits is perverted (one trait is taken to an
extreme). See Rolemaster Standard System for a complete discussion of role
traits. Note that the character may have a middle of the road trait (i.e.,
neither thrifty or frivolous) that is taken to an extreme.
@@ 3
On any statement there is a 20% chance the target lies.
@@ 4
As Trait Subversion I, except 2 traits may be perverted.
@@ 5
Target will attempt to cheat on all matters (e.g., splitting loot, card games,
etc).
@@ 6
The target has urges to commit minor property damage. When such an opportunity
arises, there is an 60% chance the target must attempt to commit such damage.
@@ 7
Target becomes a kleptomaniac and has a 10% chance of attempting to steal
anything that catches his fancy (if it does not involve violence).
@@ 8
As Trait Subversion I, except 3 traits may be perverted.
@@ 9
The target has a fascination with burning things. Every day there is a 20%
chance that he must try to burn something. He will burn things that do not
result in injury to people or animals (though there is a 1% chance that he
will injure himself in the attempt to burn things).
@@ 10
As Stealing, except target will use violence to steal.
@@ 11
As Trait Subversion I, except 5 traits may be perverted.
@@ 12
As Trait Subversion I, except a different trait will affected each day (with
the previous day’s trait reverting back to its normal state).
@@ 13
There is a 5% chance target will assault any given person when he initially
encounters him (the target must actually meet the person-this procludes people
travelling in the street).
@@ 14
As Pyromania, except target doesn’t care if people (or animals) are injured.
There is a 5% chance that he will injure himself in the attempt.
@@ 15
As Trait Subversion I, except 7 traits may be perverted.
@@ 16
As Random Trait Subversion I, except 2 traits are affected at one time.
@@ 17
As Assault, except there is a 10% chance that the target will attempt to maim
any given person.
@@ 18
As Trait Subversion I, except 10 traits may be perverted.
@@ 19
As Random Trait Subversion I, except 3 traits are affected at one time.
@@ 20
As Assault, except target attempts to kill.
@@ 25
As Assault, except target notes a person and plan to assassinate him later.
This spell lasts until the target has made an assassination attempt on the
person.
@@ 30
As Trait Subversion I, except it is permanent.
@@ 50
As Suspicion, except whenever the target is injured, suffers humiliation, or
fails in something, he will attempt suicide in some imaginative way.
